title: Complex band-limited maximum likelihood: estimating the wave behind detected quanta
abstract: arXiv:2611.28572v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Detected photons and electrons land at positions drawn from $|\psi|^2$, yet it is $\psi$, phase included, that a wave equation propagates, and the state that produced the particles is often known only in part. A density estimator can recover $|\psi|^2$ directly from the positions, without any wave equation, but it discards the phase, and with it the state. We introduce complex band-limited maximum likelihood (complex BLML), which estimates $\psi$ itself by maximising the likelihood of the detected positions over exactly the intensities the physics allows: squared moduli of complex functions whose spectrum lies in a given set, such as a band, the shape of the aperture, or several modes for a partially coherent source. A single eigenvalue can certify a global maximum. translated_title: 复数带限最大似然：估计探测到的量子背后的波
translated_abstract: 探测到的光子和电子落在由 $|\psi|^2$ 决定的位置上，然而波动方程所传播的是包含相位的 $\psi$，而产生这些粒子的量子态往往只有部分是已知的。密度估计器可以直接从探测位置恢复 $|\psi|^2$，无需借助任何波动方程，但它会丢弃相位，从而丢失量子态本身。我们提出复数带限最大似然，通过在物理所允许的强度范围内最大化探测位置的似然来直接估计 $\psi$ 本身：即谱位于给定集合（例如某个频带、孔径的形状，或部分相干源的若干模式）中的复函数的模平方。仅需一个特征值即可认证全局最大值。在模拟的双缝远场实验中，我们量化了每种先验信息的价值：频带先验在达到给定精度时所需的光子数比核密度估计少七倍，并且已经……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出复数带限最大似然方法（complex BLML），通过在物理允许的谱约束下最大化探测位置的似然，直接从粒子探测位置估计包含相位的完整波函数 $\psi$，且仅需一个特征值即可认证全局最优。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces complex band-limited maximum likelihood (complex BLML), which estimates the full complex wavefunction $\psi$ including its phase directly from detected particle positions by maximizing likelihood over physically allowed band-limited intensities, with a single eigenvalue certifying the global optimum.
